need to fix compilation errors. The test class uses JUnit5 annotations (BeforeAll, AfterAll, ParameterizedTest, etc.) but imports are wrong: they used org.junit.jupiter.* but also JUnit4 Assert static imports. The project may only have JUnit4. To compile, we can replace JUnit5 annotations with JUnit4 equivalents: @BeforeClass, @AfterClass, @Test, and for parameterized test we can use JUnit4 Parameterized runner or just remove that test. Simpler: modify imports to JUnit4: import org.junit.BeforeClass; import org.junit.AfterClass; import org.junit.runner.RunWith; import org.junit.runners.Parameterized; etc. But also we need MockBarSeries class missing; we can replace with building series directly using buildSeries. So modify test to not use MockBarSeries. Also assertThrows is JUnit5; we can replace with try-catch as later tests already do. So change that test to use try-catch.

Also BaseBarSeriesBuilder.withNumFunction doesn't exist; we can use builder without that method, then set numFunction via series? Actually BaseBarSeriesBuilder has withNumFunction in newer versions maybe not. To avoid, we can just use new BaseBarSeriesBuilder().withName("test").build(); then when creating BaseBar we need appropriate constructor. The BaseBar constructors require Duration and ZonedDateTime etc. Simpler: use org.ta4j.core.BaseBarSeriesBuilder().withName("test").withNumFunction(numFunction) maybe not present. Could instead use org.ta4j.core.BaseBarSeriesBuilder().withName("test").build(); then for BaseBar we can use new BaseBar(time, Duration.ofMinutes(1), n, n, n, n, n, DecimalNum.ZERO); However the constructors list includes one with (Duration, ZonedDateTime, Num, Num, Num, Num, Num, Num). That's likely the one. So we need to provide Duration. Use Duration.ofMinutes(1). Also we need to import java.time.Duration.

Thus modify buildSeries method accordingly.

Also need to import JUnit4 Assert.* and use assertTrue, assertEquals, fail etc already present.

Remove @ExtendWith and MockitoExtension import.

Remove @ParameterizedTest and @ValueSource imports and replace that test with a loop over values.

Simplify: create a test method that iterates over int[] invalid = {0, -5} and asserts IllegalArgumentException.

Implement using @Test.

Now adjust annotations: replace @BeforeAll with @BeforeClass static, @AfterAll with @AfterClass.

Add imports.
